seo.title: Artisanova - Marketplace for Artisanal and Handmade Goods
seo.description: Discover unique, handcrafted items from artisans around the world on Artisanova. Our curated marketplace offers high-quality products that celebrate creativity and craftsmanship.
seo.keywords: artisanal, handmade, crafts, marketplace, unique items, handcrafted, artisan products

hero.description: Explore our collection of artisanal and handmade goods, curated with care to bring you the best in creativity and quality.

about.heading: Our Story
about.paragraph: At Artisanova, we believe in the power of craftsmanship. Our platform connects art enthusiasts with artisans to showcase unique, handmade products that tell a story.

cards.title: Curated Marketplace
cards.description: Find a wide variety of artisanal and handmade goods, each with its own unique story and craftsmanship.

cards.title: Support for Artisans
cards.description: We provide a platform for artisans to reach a broader audience and showcase their unique products.
